items.title: Doug Carn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2023
items.q: No different from Johann Sebastian Bach. I keep trying to tell these idiots you’ve got to build on cumulative knowledge

ctx.x: Yeah, I was just going to ask about left hand bass because that’s a passion of mine. And I was watching you on a video that someone did in their home. And you were really wailing on the B3 and you were doing the left hand bass. And it’s a powerful feeling because you can really control the music. You’re the bass player and the soloist, and the chordal person.
No different from Johann Sebastian Bach. I keep trying to tell these idiots you’ve got to build on cumulative knowledge you know, and you can’t reinvent the wheel yourself.
Do you think differently or play different — well I’m going to say do you think differently when you have a bass player?
